azure_wolf.name: Azure Wolf Bloodline
azure_wolf.trait: Tracking instinct, endurance and coordinated hunting

vermilion_bird.name: Vermilion Bird Emberline
vermilion_bird.trait: Fire affinity and resilience to heat

white_tiger.name: White Tiger Warline
white_tiger.trait: Battle instinct, killing intent and weapon affinity

moon_serpent.name: Moon Serpent Yin Line
moon_serpent.trait: Yin sensitivity, concealment and poison resistance

thunder_roc.name: Thunder Roc Lineage
thunder_roc.trait: Speed, lightning affinity and aerial techniques

jade_river.name: Jade River Spirit Line
jade_river.trait: Water affinity, healing intuition and river-sense

stone_bear.name: Stone Bear Ancestry
stone_bear.trait: Powerful physique, endurance and mountain survival

nine_yang_solar_body.name: Nine-Yang Solar Body
nine_yang_solar_body.advantage: Explosive yang vitality and fire-compatible body refinement.
nine_yang_solar_body.drawback: Excess yang scorches the meridians and makes Yin cultivation harder.

extreme_yin_moon_vessel.name: Extreme-Yin Moon Vessel
extreme_yin_moon_vessel.advantage: Exceptional Yin perception, soul stability and cold affinity.
extreme_yin_moon_vessel.drawback: Cold meridians hinder explosive physical force.

vajra_bone_body.name: Vajra Bone Body
vajra_bone_body.advantage: Dense bones, great endurance and resistance to direct impact.
vajra_bone_body.drawback: Heavy bones reduce agility and make movement arts harder.

myriad_poison_vessel.name: Myriad-Poison Vessel
myriad_poison_vessel.advantage: Poisons can be refined into resistance and cultivated strength.
myriad_poison_vessel.drawback: The vessel is chronically toxic and socially feared.

innate_sword_embryo.name: Innate Sword Embryo
innate_sword_embryo.advantage: The body naturally resonates with swords and sharp intent.
innate_sword_embryo.drawback: Its meridians reject blunt, beast and heavy-body methods.

heavenly_lightning_meridians.name: Heavenly-Lightning Meridians
heavenly_lightning_meridians.drawback: Unstable surges strain concentration and inner calm.

five_elements_dao_body.name: Five-Elements Dao Body
five_elements_dao_body.advantage: Broad elemental compatibility and exceptional formation balance.
five_elements_dao_body.drawback: Every advance requires balancing several conflicting energies.

void_meridian_body.name: Void-Meridian Body
void_meridian_body.advantage: Unusual spatial perception and concealment within the void.
void_meridian_body.drawback: Fragile physical meridians make direct body tempering dangerous.

Greenriver Town.description: A mortal town beneath the Azure Reed Sect, surrounded by rice terraces, spirit-herb gardens and the misty Jade River.
encounters: A wounded spirit fox watches from beneath a broken shrine.
A merchant argues that his spirit-stone crate was replaced with river rocks.
An old fisherman hears a bronze bell ringing below the river.
A group of outer disciples accuse a villager of stealing a medicinal herb.
A night-blooming spirit orchid opens beside an abandoned grave.
A traveling storyteller claims a sealed ruin has appeared in the eastern hills.
sense_hints: Several mortal life-signs cluster around the market and river docks.
The old city gate carries faint spiritual residue from years of cultivator traffic.

Cloudspine Foothills.description: Steep cedar forests and broken stone paths leading toward old cultivation caves and abandoned formation towers.
encounters: A damaged formation repeats the same birdsong every seven breaths.
Three iron-horn boars uproot spirit herbs near a cliff path.
A rival sect scouting party demands to know why you crossed their marker stones.
A cave entrance exhales cold spiritual mist despite the summer heat.
A sword embedded in a boulder hums when cultivators approach.
sense_hints: Thin formation fluctuations drift between the cliffs.
Spirit-beast auras appear and vanish among the higher ridges.

Moonfen Marsh.description: A dangerous wetland rich in medicinal plants, poisonous insects, ghost-lotus flowers and hidden alchemist camps.
encounters: Blue ghost-lotus petals drift upstream against the current.
A poisoned herb gatherer collapses near a stand of black reeds.
A giant marsh crane guards a patch of rare medicinal moss.
A masked alchemist offers to trade an unnamed pill for fresh beast blood.
Pale lights circle an old grave mound without casting reflections.
sense_hints: Water and Yin qi interfere with precise spiritual scanning.
Something beneath the mud occasionally disturbs the local spiritual current.

Golden Pavilion Auction House.description: A many-tiered auction pavilion protected by ancient formations and discreet hidden experts. Violence inside is forbidden; the protection ends at the front doors.
encounters: A veiled bidder overpays for a cracked jade slip and leaves before the gavel falls.
Two appraisers argue in whispers over whether a beast core is a fake — and then fall silent when Steward Qiao passes.
A porter drops a sealed crate; something inside knocks back, once.
A notice on the consignment board offers a reward for the return of a lot that was never listed.
A young cultivator tries to sell a manual page by page and is politely shown the door.
The formation lamps flicker for a breath, and every hidden expert in the hall looks at the same balcony.
sense_hints: The pavilion's formations press evenly from every wall; nothing inside reads as more than it wants to be.
Several concealed presences sit above the auction floor, their power folded down to a whisper.
A sharp spike of greed and fear rises from the bidding tiers with every gavel.

Azure Crown Imperial City.description: The capital of the dominant mortal dynasty, filled with noble clans, ministries, sect envoys and imperial guards. The city functions as a complete family starting region with local trade, cultivation resources, household politics, work, and recurring problems.
encounters: A steward from a local cultivation family asks for help with a succession dispute spilling into the streets.
The inner-city market is trading tribute goods, but a sudden shortage has pushed smaller shops into a bidding dispute.
A resource seeker claims a fresh cache of tribute goods has appeared beyond the safest streets and wants a partner.
Two junior cultivators from rival local households turn a routine disagreement in Azure Crown Imperial City into a public challenge.
A traveling artisan posts court commissions on the city notice board, offering payment, reputation, or family favor.
sense_hints: Thousands of mortal and cultivator auras overlap behind the capital formations.
Several guarded spiritual signatures move between the palace, clan districts and sect embassies.

Spirit Jade Capital.description: A vast Spiritual World capital built around a jade ley-line nexus where ascended sects and ancient families bargain for influence.
encounters: Ascended cultivators gather around a jade plaza where sect representatives recruit proven juniors.
An ancient family convoy arrives beneath a canopy of spirit banners and protective formations.
A formation scholar demonstrates a temporary qi array to a crowd of artisans.
Rumors spread that an underworld broker changed meeting places somewhere in the capital district.
A public law-stele flickers as several cultivators compare comprehension insights.
sense_hints: A jade ley-line nexus makes spiritual sense unusually vivid but crowded.
High-level auras are common enough here that individual experts are difficult to isolate.

Nine-Heavens Immortal Court.description: The central court of an Immortal World domain, suspended above immortal clouds and guarded by law formations.
encounters: Immortal clan delegates debate a territorial petition beneath floating law tablets.
A cloud-market convoy docks at the court and unloads rare immortal-grade materials.
Formation masters inspect damage to a public transit array linking distant domains.
An immortal official quietly asks for witnesses to a recent forbidden-art incident.
Cultivators gather at a star-viewing terrace to exchange rumors about secret realms and heavenly phenomena.
sense_hints: Immortal law formations layer space so densely that distant courtyards feel only a step apart.
The strongest auras are deliberately veiled by court etiquette and defensive arrays.

Celestial Mandate Palace.description: A palace-city at the heart of the Celestial World, where sovereign decrees can redirect the fate of entire star regions.
encounters: Celestial envoys arrive through a sovereign gate carrying decrees from distant star regions.
A heavenly market opens beneath a rotating constellation array for only a few hours.
Law cultivators gather around a mandate stele to debate the consequences of a recent cosmic omen.
A great clan requests neutral witnesses for negotiations that could alter several celestial territories.
The palace formations briefly resonate with a distant tribulation, drawing powerful cultivators into the plazas.
sense_hints: Sovereign law formations suppress hostile intent without dulling spiritual perception.
Countless celestial signatures overlap with traces of fate, law and ancient bloodlines.

Spirit Jade Rebirth Enclave.description: A protected lower district in the Spiritual World where mortal-born descendants, reincarnated souls and weak juniors can survive beneath stabilizing formations.
sense_hints: Layered formations soften the Spiritual World pressure around newborn souls.
encounters: A reincarnated soul in a child's body recites a sect oath nobody here has heard for a century.
A formation warden replaces a cracked stabilising tile and mutters that the pressure outside is rising.
Two mortal-born juniors trade rumours about which ancestor is paying for their protection.
A caravan from the capital delivers spirit rice and takes away a list of names.
An old woman insists she has been reborn here twice and that the enclave is smaller each time.

Nine-Heavens Rebirth Terrace.description: A sheltered Immortal World terrace maintained for newborn clan members and reincarnated souls whose bodies have not yet rebuilt immortal cultivation.
sense_hints: Immortal qi is filtered through ancient cradle formations so fragile bodies are not destroyed.
encounters: A newborn immortal, three days old, stares at the filtered sky and weeps for a court that no longer exists.
A terrace attendant quietly moves a family from the outer ring to the inner one after a letter arrives.
A crack in a cradle formation lets a breath of raw immortal qi through; a junior collapses, then laughs.
A visiting elder inspects the reincarnated with the eyes of someone looking for one face in particular.
A servant is caught copying names off the rebirth ledger and is escorted away without a word.

Celestial Cradle Province.description: A rare Celestial World province protected by sovereign law formations, allowing reincarnated souls to begin again in mortal-strength bodies without being crushed by the realm itself.
sense_hints: The local laws bend gently around newborn souls, suppressing otherwise lethal celestial pressure.
encounters: The sovereign law formation hums a note lower than yesterday, and every attendant pretends not to notice.
A reincarnated soul remembers the Celestial Mandate Palace from the inside and will not say how.
Provincial clerks re-register a family under a new name at the empress's written instruction.
A mortal-strength body sits in meditation for the first time and the surrounding grass bends toward it.
A sealed message from the Immortal World arrives addressed to a child born this morning.

Azure Cloud Mountain Gate.description: A white-stone stairway climbs through cloud-wrapped pines to the public mountain gate of the Azure Cloud Sect. Sword marks left by generations of applicants cover the testing plaza.
encounters: An applicant collapses on the ninth hundred step and refuses the hand offered to him.
Gate Elder Jian Mu reads a recommendation letter twice, then folds it without comment.
A cloud lifts and, for a moment, the inner peaks show a sword hall no applicant is meant to see.
Two rejected applicants argue over whether the testing plaza's oldest sword mark is real.
A pine branch snaps under fresh snow and every outer disciple on the stair draws at once.
A merchant at the foot of the stair sells 'lucky' whetstones to the hopeful.
sense_hints: Sword intent clings to the testing plaza, layered by generations of applicants.
The gate's protective formation runs the full height of the stair and stops exactly at the last step.
Higher up the mountain, disciplined qi moves in ordered lines, out of reach of sense.

Crimson Furnace Valley.description: Red cliffs surround a furnace valley veined with fire-aspected qi. Herb terraces, pill halls and bronze examination furnaces mark the Crimson Furnace Sect recruitment grounds.
encounters: A bronze examination furnace overheats and the pill inside turns to glass; an elder calls it a lesson.
A herb terrace has been picked clean overnight and the gardeners blame the valley's fire-ants.
A junior alchemist offers to sell you a failed pill 'for practice'.
Two disciples carry a third out of the pill hall, his eyebrows gone.
The cliffs breathe warm air at dusk and someone has scratched a name into the heat-cracked stone.
A furnace-keeper asks, too casually, whether you have ever handled fire-aspected qi before.
sense_hints: Fire-aspected qi rises from the valley floor in slow pulses, strongest near the bronze furnaces.
The herb terraces carry a green, medicinal spiritual scent that masks weaker signatures.
Heat-shimmer around the pill halls makes every life-sign there hard to count.

Frozen Moon Terrace.description: A high terrace above a cold mirror-lake where frost formations glow beneath moonstone tiles. Frozen Moon Palace tests patience, control and formation sense here.
encounters: A formation on the mirror-lake completes itself without anyone touching it, and a disciple is quietly sent for.
An applicant has been standing motionless on the moonstone tiles since dawn; nobody says whether that is the test.
Frost climbs a bronze brazier and puts out a fire that was never lit.
A Frozen Moon attendant offers tea that stays warm for exactly one breath.
Two disciples debate whether the lake's ice is thicker at the centre or the edge; both are wrong.
A moonstone tile is missing and the gap has been marked with a single frozen plum blossom.
sense_hints: Cold, still qi lies over the mirror-lake like a second surface; ripples in it are formations, not water.
Moonstone tiles hold a faint stored light that answers to patience rather than pressure.
Whatever watches from the palace above keeps its presence perfectly level.

Black Serpent Ravine.description: A humid ravine of black bamboo, beast pens and poison gardens. The Black Serpent Clan judges recruits by fieldcraft, nerve and their respect for dangerous creatures.
encounters: A beast pen stands open and the handlers are more interested in your reaction than the escape.
A poison-garden warden asks you to identify a plant by smell alone.
Something long moves beneath the black bamboo and the clan children fall silent to listen.
A recruit is carried past with a purpling bite and a look of pride.
A clan elder skins a river serpent in three cuts and offers you the knife.
Bamboo tally-sticks by the pens count something nobody explains.
sense_hints: Beast life-signs crowd the pens and the bamboo, some of them large and awake.
Poison-aspected qi seeps from the gardens and dulls the edge of spiritual sense.
The clan's own cultivators are hard to place; they keep their presence low the way their beasts do.

Blood River Gorge.description: A hidden gorge where iron-red water cuts through dark stone. Blood River banners appear only to those who have been shown the correct trail or survived long enough to be noticed.
encounters: A banner shows itself on the far bank and is gone before you can read the character on it.
The iron-red water runs briefly clear; a disciple on the rocks looks alarmed rather than pleased.
A Blood River initiate practises a palm strike against the cliff until her knuckles run.
A sentry asks who showed you the trail, and does not wait long for the answer.
Bones in the shallows have been arranged into a character that means 'welcome' — or 'payment'.
A wounded hunter offers to trade a beast core for silence about where he came from.
sense_hints: The iron-red water carries a faint, hungry blood qi that tugs at the meridians.
Hostile attention rests on the gorge from at least two vantage points on the cliffs.
Something old has been fed here, and the stone remembers it.

Corpse Lantern Necropolis.description: A concealed funerary complex lit by blue soul-lanterns. Names of the dead are carved into black tablets while quiet archivists test whether visitors can face death without losing themselves.
encounters: An archivist reads a name from a black tablet and a soul-lantern along the wall brightens.
A visitor sits before a tablet carved with their own name and does not seem surprised.
A blue lantern gutters and the archivists stop work until it steadies.
A newly carved tablet is still wet with ink; the date on it is tomorrow.
Two quiet attendants carry a lantern between them as if it were heavy.
A voice from an unlit alcove asks whether you came here to remember or to be forgotten.
sense_hints: Soul-aspected qi hangs in the blue lantern-light, cold and patient.
The black tablets each hold a faint residual presence, as if the names were listening.
No living heat reads from the archivists; their signatures are thin and steady as lamp flames.

Riverguard City.description: A public temperate cultivation city shaped by temperate river martial district. Its family districts are part of the normal world: travelers can discover, visit, trade, and interact here. The city functions as a complete family starting region with local trade, cultivation resources, household politics, work, and recurring problems.
encounters: A steward from a local cultivation family asks for help with a patrol line under pressure.
The garrison market is trading weapon timber, but a sudden shortage has pushed smaller shops into a bidding dispute.
A resource seeker claims a fresh cache of weapon timber has appeared beyond the safest streets and wants a partner.
Two junior cultivators from rival local households turn a routine disagreement in Riverguard City into a public challenge.
A traveling artisan posts escort contracts on the city notice board, offering payment, reputation, or family favor.
sense_hints: Roads, caravans, and cultivator rumors point toward Riverguard City.
The city's temperate river martial district leave a recognizable spiritual signature.

Azure Crown Treasure Exchange.description: A colonnaded hall under the imperial crest where licensed brokers call lots from a raised dais. Court formations hum in the pillars; imperial guards line the gallery. Violence inside is a crime against the throne; the licence, and the guard, end at the gate.
encounters: A broker rings the dais bell three times and a whole gallery of buyers goes silent for a sealed imperial lot.
Two merchant heirs bid each other into ruin over a jade seal neither can read.
A court appraiser turns a spirit herb in the lamplight and quietly moves it to the reserve table.
A palace runner arrives with a scroll, and one lot is withdrawn without explanation.
sense_hints: The court formation in the pillars presses down evenly; qi raised above a whisper is flattened at once.
Imperial guards along the gallery carry more cultivation than their plain armour admits.
Greed and caution thread through the crowd in equal measure, sharpening at every call of the bell.

Spirit Jade Auction Pavilion.description: A pavilion of pale jade tiers rising around a suspended auction dais, lit from within by the capital's spirit veins. An array woven into the jade suppresses every technique on the floor; ascended families bid from private balconies. Past the jade doors the array ends.
encounters: A masked family elder bids from a private balcony through a veiled attendant, never once showing her face.
An appraiser cracks a spirit stone to test its grade and the whole tier smells of rain for a breath.
A lot of ascended-beast marrow draws three sect envoys to their feet at the same instant.
The jade array chimes once, softly, and a would-be technique on the floor dies unborn.
sense_hints: The jade array threads every tier; qi gathered for a technique thins to nothing before it can form.
Ascended cultivators sit behind the balcony veils, their auras folded to embers.
Old money and older grudges hang in the pavilion air, patient and cold.

Nine-Heavens Treasure Hall.description: A vast hall of white stone and star-metal beneath the Court's own law formation, where immortal clans auction relics older than the Mortal World's dynasties. The formation forbids a raised hand as firmly as a raised blade. The law stops at the threshold.
encounters: A clan patriarch bids a whole mountain estate for a single immortal seed and does not look up from his tea.
The law formation brightens above one balcony and every voice in the hall lowers at once.
An arbiter's clerk reads a relic's provenance aloud for a quarter of an hour, and nobody interrupts.
A lot is struck from the register mid-call; the hall learns later that its seller no longer exists.
sense_hints: The Court's law formation reads intent itself; a hostile thought draws a pressure like a held breath.
Immortal auras crowd the balconies, ancient and unhurried, each one a weight on the air.
Relics on the dais hum with ages of accumulated law; the hall feels older than the Court around it.

Celestial Mandate Auction Hall.description: A hall of pale gold and living cloud beneath the Mandate's own seal, where sovereign courts trade in treasures that shape worlds. A blow struck on this floor is a blow against heaven, and heaven answers. The Mandate's shelter ends at the hall doors.
encounters: A sovereign's envoy bids with a single raised finger and the price doubles in silence.
The Mandate seal overhead flares as a lot of world-essence is uncovered, and the cloud floor goes still.
Two heavenly factions trade through intermediaries who never look at each other.
A steward's herald announces a lot withdrawn by decree; no one asks whose.
sense_hints: The Mandate seal overhead weighs on every aura in the hall; even celestial qi bends to it.
Sovereign presences fill the upper cloud tiers like slow storms, each aware of the others.
Treasures on the dais carry the pull of whole worlds; the floor itself seems to lean toward them.

Riverguard Riverside Auction Hall.description: A long hall on stilts over Riverguard City's martial landings, where river barges unload lots straight onto the auction floor. A water formation stills every blade on the floor; the city guards watch the landings. The stilling ends at the gangway.
encounters: A barge master sells a crate unopened and the whole floor bids on the sound it makes when it is set down.
Two martial-district captains bid against each other for a spirit stone lot and settle it with a bow instead of a blade.
An appraiser weighs a river pearl in her palm and quietly halves its reserve.
The landing bell rings for a lot arriving late by water, and the bidding starts before it is ashore.
sense_hints: The water formation under the floor hums through the planks; a raised blade would stop mid-draw.
River qi moves under the hall in slow, cold pulses, carrying the smell of wet stone and spirit stone dust.
The martial district's pride sits in every posture on the floor, held carefully in check.

The landing bell rings for a lot arriving late by water, and the bidding starts before it is ashore.
sense_hints: The water formation under the floor hums through the planks; a raised blade would stop mid-draw.
River qi moves under the hall in slow, cold pulses, carrying the smell of wet stone and immortal stone dust.
The martial district's pride sits in every posture on the floor, held carefully in check.

A water formation stills every blade on the floor; the celestial wardens watch the landings. The stilling ends at the gangway.

Four-Roads Caravan Crossroads Auction Ya.description: A walled yard at the meeting of Four-Roads Caravan City's trade roads, roofed in canvas and lit by lanterns, where caravans auction whole loads at once. A road formation in the flagstones keeps the peace; the city guards keep the gates. Peace, and the gates, end at the road.
encounters: A caravan master auctions an entire wagon sight unseen and three trading houses bid on the dust it arrived in.
A lantern goes out over one stall and the yard's auctioneer calls the next lot without missing a breath.
Two rival guilds send the same clerk to bid for both, and nobody on the floor is fooled.
A spirit stone purse changes hands under the canvas so quickly that the yard's tally clerk has to ask twice.
sense_hints: The road formation in the flagstones pulls hostile intent flat, like a wind dying at a wall.
Dust, lantern smoke and a dozen caravans' worth of spirit stone scent hang under the canvas.
Every guild on the floor is counting every other guild's purses, and pretending not to.

Emberforge Furnace Auction Gallery.description: A gallery cut into Emberforge City's forge terraces, its floor warmed by the volcanic veins below, where smiths and miners auction ore, blades and furnace-born treasures. A fire formation keeps every blade cool on the floor; the city guards stand at the vents. The formation cools nothing past the gallery mouth.
encounters: A smith's apprentice carries a still-warm blade to the dais and the gallery leans forward as one.
An ore lot cracks in its crate from the heat and the reserve is quietly doubled.
Two forge clans bid on the same furnace core until the auctioneer stops the call for the good of both.
A vent sighs below the floor and every spirit stone on the tally table shifts a finger's width.
sense_hints: The fire formation drinks the heat of a raised blade before it can be drawn; the gallery stays cool as stone.
Volcanic qi breathes up through the floor in slow waves, sharp with sulphur and spirit stone smoke.
Forge clans keep their tempers folded like good steel, and the gallery feels it.

Stoneback Mountain Highland Auction Lodg.description: A timber-and-stone lodge on Stoneback Mountain City's highest terrace, where hunters, miners and highland clans auction pelts, ore and mountain-born spirit herbs. A stone formation holds the floor still; the city guards keep the lodge doors. The stillness, and the wardens, end on the path.
encounters: A highland hunter unrolls a pelt across the dais and the lodge goes quiet at the size of it.
A mountain clan bids in ore by weight, and the tally clerk fetches a second scale.
Snow slides from the lodge roof mid-call and nobody on the floor looks up.
An old prospector sells a single spirit stone the size of a fist and refuses every offer for the vein it came from.
sense_hints: The stone formation in the lodge floor grounds every surge of qi like a mountain taking a footstep.
Thin cold air and pine resin fill the lodge, cut with the mineral bite of spirit stone ore.
Highland clans watch one another across the floor with the patience of people who wait out winters.

Cloudblade Sword Peak Auction Terrace.description: An open terrace on the highest of Cloudblade City's sword peaks, walled by wind, where sword cultivators auction blades, manuals and battle-won trophies. A wind formation turns every drawn sword aside; the city guards keep the stair. Past the stair the wind, and the peace, are the peaks' own.
encounters: A sword cultivator lays her blade on the dais and the wind on the terrace changes direction.
Two disciples of rival peaks bid on one manual and their masters pretend not to watch.
A trophy from a duel is auctioned by the loser, who stands at the back and does not bid.
The wind formation sings once as a blade half-clears its sheath, and the sheath swallows it again.
sense_hints: The wind formation on the terrace tugs every raised blade wide; sword qi cannot hold a line here.
High cold wind scours the terrace, carrying the ring of spirit stone on stone and distant sword drills.
Sword intent crowds the terrace from every side, sharp, proud and carefully sheathed.

Ironbanner Bannered Auction Ground.description: A drilled square inside Ironbanner City's walls, hung with clan banners, where garrisons and plains clans auction arms, mounts and the spoils of the frontier. A banner formation forbids a drawn weapon on the ground; the city guards hold the gate. The banner's peace ends at the wall.
encounters: A garrison captain auctions a captured banner and the clan it belonged to sends a bidder anyway.
A string of plains mounts is walked across the ground and the bidding follows their hooves.
A dust wind crosses the square and the auctioneer calls through it without a pause.
A spirit stone purse is thrown onto the dais from the back rank, and the tally clerk counts it twice.
sense_hints: The banner formation over the ground weighs on every hand that drifts toward a hilt.
Dry wind, horse and iron: the square smells of a garrison, with spirit stone dust under it.
Clan pride stands in ranks on this ground, banners up, tempers held at parade rest.

Moonfen Mistwater Auction Pavilion.description: A lantern-lit pavilion on pilings over Moonfen City's marsh channels, where yin cultivators, herbalists and fen traders auction reagents, relics and things pulled from the mist. A water-mirror formation stills the floor; the city guards pole the channels. The mirror ends at the last piling.
encounters: A fen trader sets a sealed jar on the dais and the mist inside it moves against the lantern light.
A yin cultivator bids without speaking, and the keeper reads the price off the cold in the air.
A relic dredged from the channels is auctioned still wet, and no one asks what it was attached to.
The lanterns dim as a lot of spirit stone is uncovered, and brighten when the reserve is met.
sense_hints: The water-mirror formation under the pilings shows every hostile thought back at its owner, chilled.
Mist, rot and cold marsh qi seep through the pavilion, threaded with spirit stone light.
The fen's yin cultivators sit very still on the floor, and the stillness has weight.

Frostwatch Frontier Auction Hall.description: A stone hall banked with snow at Frostwatch City's frontier gate, where scouts, trappers and border clans auction furs, ice-born spirit herbs and what the frozen wastes give up. A frost formation stops every blade in its sheath; the city guards man the gate. The frost's peace ends where the road turns north.
encounters: A scout auctions a map of the wastes drawn in her own blood, and two border clans bid without reading it.
An ice-born herb is carried in frozen and auctioned before it can thaw.
The gate horn sounds for a patrol returning, and the floor pauses to count them in.
A trapper drops a pelt worth a season's spirit stone on the dais and asks only for a warm bed in exchange.
sense_hints: The frost formation lays a rime on any hand that closes on a weapon; steel here is too cold to draw.
Woodsmoke, wet fur and the clean bite of the wastes fill the hall, with spirit stone glinting in the frost.
Border clans keep their eyes on the gate as much as the dais; the frontier is never quite outside.

Ashenwall Relic Auction Court.description: A roofed court raised on the old battlefield walls of Ashenwall City, where relic hunters, scholars and salvage clans auction what the ruins give up. A ward formation older than the city keeps the floor bloodless; the city guards guard the arches. Beyond the arches the old ground keeps its own rules.
encounters: A relic hunter uncovers a broken standard on the dais and three salvage clans claim its lineage at once.
A scholar bids a year's stipend for a single inscribed shard and reads it aloud before the gavel.
Something in a sealed crate answers the auctioneer's bell, and the reserve goes up.
A salvage clan pays in spirit stone pried from a battlefield vault, still stamped with a dead army's seal.
sense_hints: The ward formation in the old walls presses down like a sleeping army's discipline; it predates the city.
Dust, old iron and the faint residue of ancient qi hang in the court, with spirit stone glimmering in the cracks.
The ruins' past crowds the arches; every relic on the dais remembers a battle.

A basket of rare herbs is sold for spirit stone and carried out under a wet cloth before it can wilt.
sense_hints: The verdant formation in the floor cools anger like shade; nobody on this floor stays furious long.
Crushed herbs, damp earth and pill fire scent the hall, with the green tang of spirit stone in the soil.
Physicians and garden clans study every lot the way they study a patient, and each other the same.

Jade Crown Noble Auction Court.description: A marble court in Jade Crown Spirit City's noble quarter, hung with house crests, where old families auction heirlooms, estates and the favours of the heartland. A court formation forbids a raised voice as well as a raised hand; the ascended wardens attend the doors. Past the doors the families keep their own courtesies.
encounters: A noble house auctions a lesser heirloom to settle a debt and every rival house bids to be seen doing it.
A crest is quietly taken down from the wall before a lot is called, and quietly returned after.
Two young heirs bid against each other for an estate neither has visited.
A matriarch buys back her own family's jade for spirit crystal and does not look at who sold it.
sense_hints: The court formation smooths every aura on the floor to a courtier's calm; sharp intent simply fails to form.
Polished marble, sandalwood and old money scent the court, with spirit crystal light in the crests.
Every house on the floor is keeping score of every other, in silence, and always has.

Adamant Body Immortal City East Gate.description: The east gate of Adamant Body Immortal City, facing the road to Solar Furnace Immortal City. a gatehouse, a queue of carts, a guard post that checks every cultivator's token and a board of the city's notices. Everyone who arrives by road arrives here, and the streets of Adamant Body Immortal City begin a step inside.
encounters: A guard checks a cultivator's sect token against the notice board and waves them through with a nod.
A cart of spirit herbs is held at the gate while the toll is argued over.
A notice is nailed up: a bounty, a wedding, and a warning about the roads after dark.
A returning hunting party comes through the gate with something wrapped in hide that is still moving.
sense_hints: The gate's warding array hums under the arch; every token that passes leaves a flicker of its sect's qi.
Road dust, mule sweat and a hundred faint qi signatures pass through the arch every hour.

A vein of spirit iron shows in a fresh cut and the whole terrace comes to look.
The ore terrace pays out and the tavern below fills before sunset.
Miners come up the switchback grey with dust and singing badly.
sense_hints: Earth qi and spirit iron ring from the mine mouths; the freshest vein is the loudest.
Dust, sweat and the deep patient pressure of the mountain.

Ashenwall Ruin Quarter.description: The ruin quarter of Ashenwall City: the old battlefield inside the walls, weathered and half-cleared, where diggers sell what the ground gives up and the sentries watch for what it wakes.
encounters: The old sentry walks the same line of broken wall she has walked for forty years.
A dig turns up bones and a seal, and the diggers argue over which to report.
Something under the rubble hums when a cultivator walks over it and stops when they look.
A collector from Ashenwall City buys a cracked mirror for far too much and leaves quickly.
sense_hints: Old battle qi bleeds from the ground; a sense finds blades, banners and bones under the rubble.
Something below hums at the edge of hearing and answers when a cultivator's qi touches it.

An invitation is delivered to a compound gate and refused without being opened.
Lanterns are lit along a wall for a banquet that half of Azure Crown Imperial City is talking about.

The lanes are still and the compounds are not; power breathes behind the lacquered gates.

Azure Crown East District.description: Azure Crown's temple quarter: incense, bells and the envoys' halls where the sects keep a presence in Azure Crown Imperial City. Pilgrims and disciples cross the well-swept courtyards at every hour, and rumour travels faster than prayer.
encounters: Two envoys from rival sects bow to each other with exact and equal coldness.
A notice at the hall names the disciples accepted this season, and a crowd reads it twice.
A bell rings and the courtyard empties as disciples file into the envoys' hall.
An incense seller offers a stick for luck on a trial and a second for the examiner.
sense_hints: Incense and sect qi thicken the courtyards; a spiritual sense finds three sects' signatures in one breath.
Bells leave a ringing in the qi that lasts long after the sound is gone.

Azure Crown South District.description: Azure Crown's lower town: the crowded, well-swept streets below the walls where Azure Crown Imperial City actually lives - inns, laundries, gambling dens and the people who hear everything first.
encounters: An innkeeper waves you in, out of the rain, before you have said a word.
A gambling den's shutters bang open and someone comes out lighter than they went in.
A laundress hangs a sect robe out to dry and pretends not to know whose it is.
Children run a race down the alley and a cultivator steps aside for them without breaking stride.
sense_hints: Mortal life-signs crowd every alley; the cultivators among them are easy to pick out and try not to be.
Smoke, wet stone and cheap wine, and under it the quick pulse of a place that never sleeps.

Azure Crown West District.description: Azure Crown's ministry row: well-swept halls of clerks, petitioners in queues, seals and stamps and the slow, exact machinery by which Azure Crown Imperial City is governed.
encounters: A sect envoy is shown past the queue and everyone in it notices.
The day's edicts are posted and a scribe reads them aloud for the crowd.
Two clerks argue over the wording of a decree that will change nothing.
A clerk stamps a petition with three seals and returns it for a fourth.
sense_hints: Paper, ink and the dry bureaucratic qi of a thousand sealed decisions.
The seals on the halls carry the mandate's authority in a thin, exact line.

Celestial River River Landings.description: The river landings of Celestial River City: well-swept quays where the barges tie up, nets dry on the rails, and the martial district's captains keep an eye on what comes ashore.

The landing bell rings for a barge nobody was expecting.
sense_hints: River qi moves under the quays in slow cold pulses; the barges carry the smell of every town upstream.

Road dust, mule sweat and a hundred faint qi signatures pass through the arch every hour.

Moonfrost Mist Docks.description: The mist docks of Moonfrost Spirit City: mist-hung jetties over black water, ferries appearing out of the fog, and the lamplit sheds where the night catch is sorted.
encounters: Mist rolls up the jetty and the sheds lose their shapes one by one.
A ferry appears out of the fog with a lantern and no passengers anyone recognises.
The night catch is sorted under lamps: fish, eels, and one thing thrown back fast.
A fishmonger names a price for a river pearl she has not shown anyone yet.
sense_hints: Water qi and something under it, slow and cold and watching the jetties.
The fog carries the catch, the lamp oil and the faint wrongness of the black water.

Nine-Heavens North District.description: Nine-Heavens's noble quarter: walled compounds, lacquered gates and servants who do not look at strangers. The great clans of Nine-Heavens Immortal Court keep their townhouses here, and the well-swept lanes between them are swept twice a day.
encounters: An invitation is delivered to a compound gate and refused without being opened.
Lanterns are lit along a wall for a banquet that half of Nine-Heavens Immortal Court is talking about.
A sedan chair passes with its curtains drawn and every servant on the lane bows to it.
Two clan stewards argue over a boundary stone in voices too quiet to carry.
sense_hints: Clan qi sits behind every wall, old and layered, and none of it is offered to a stranger.
The lanes are still and the compounds are not; power breathes behind the lacquered gates.

Nine-Heavens East District.description: Nine-Heavens's temple quarter: incense, bells and the envoys' halls where the sects keep a presence in Nine-Heavens Immortal Court. Pilgrims and disciples cross the well-swept courtyards at every hour, and rumour travels faster than prayer.
encounters: A bell rings and the courtyard empties as disciples file into the envoys' hall.
An incense seller offers a stick for luck on a trial and a second for the examiner.
A pilgrim asks the way to a sect gate and is told three different roads.
Two envoys from rival sects bow to each other with exact and equal coldness.
sense_hints: Incense and sect qi thicken the courtyards; a spiritual sense finds three sects' signatures in one breath.
Bells leave a ringing in the qi that lasts long after the sound is gone.

Nine-Heavens South District.description: Nine-Heavens's lower town: the crowded, well-swept streets below the walls where Nine-Heavens Immortal Court actually lives - inns, laundries, gambling dens and the people who hear everything first.
encounters: A laundress hangs a sect robe out to dry and pretends not to know whose it is.
Children run a race down the alley and a cultivator steps aside for them without breaking stride.
Someone in a doorway knows what happened at the gate this morning and will tell you for a coin.
An innkeeper waves you in, out of the rain, before you have said a word.
sense_hints: Mortal life-signs crowd every alley; the cultivators among them are easy to pick out and try not to be.
Smoke, wet stone and cheap wine, and under it the quick pulse of a place that never sleeps.

Nine-Heavens West District.description: Nine-Heavens's ministry row: well-swept halls of clerks, petitioners in queues, seals and stamps and the slow, exact machinery by which Nine-Heavens Immortal Court is governed.
encounters: Two clerks argue over the wording of a decree that will change nothing.
A clerk stamps a petition with three seals and returns it for a fourth.
A petitioner who has waited since dawn is told to come back tomorrow, kindly.
A sect envoy is shown past the queue and everyone in it notices.
sense_hints: Paper, ink and the dry bureaucratic qi of a thousand sealed decisions.
The seals on the halls carry the mandate's authority in a thin, exact line.

Northwind Frost Market.description: The frost market of Northwind Spirit City: a frost-rimed square of braziers and fur-hung stalls where the frontier trades furs, salt and news, and everyone stands close to a fire.
encounters: Salt is weighed against spirit stones on a scale that has to be thawed first.
A stall sells hot wine and the news of every fort on the frontier.
A fur trader spreads a white pelt across a brazier's light and the square goes quiet.
The fire keeper feeds the braziers and takes a coin from every stall for the wood.
sense_hints: Braziers make islands of fire qi in a square that is otherwise frozen to the bone.
Fur, salt and smoke, and the frontier's watchfulness in every stallholder.

Riverguard River Landings.description: The river landings of Riverguard City: well-swept quays where the barges tie up, nets dry on the rails, and the martial district's captains keep an eye on what comes ashore.
encounters: A martial captain walks the quay and the barges tie up a little straighter.
A river spirit is seen under the landing and a coin is thrown in for it.
The landing bell rings for a barge nobody was expecting.
A barge master unloads a crate straight onto the quay and the auction runners are already there.
sense_hints: River qi moves under the quays in slow cold pulses; the barges carry the smell of every town upstream.
The martial district's pride stands on the landing like a second guard.

Ruined Constellation Ruin Quarter.description: The ruin quarter of Ruined Constellation City: the old battlefield inside the walls, weathered and half-cleared, where diggers sell what the ground gives up and the sentries watch for what it wakes.
encounters: The old sentry walks the same line of broken wall she has walked for forty years.
A dig turns up bones and a seal, and the diggers argue over which to report.
Something under the rubble hums when a cultivator walks over it and stops when they look.
A collector from Ruined Constellation City buys a cracked mirror for far too much and leaves quickly.
sense_hints: Old battle qi bleeds from the ground; a sense finds blades, banners and bones under the rubble.
Something below hums at the edge of hearing and answers when a cultivator's qi touches it.

Skyroad Caravan Yards.description: The caravan yards of Skyroad Immortal City: road-worn acres of wagons, mules and hired guards, where every road in the region begins or ends and a rumour costs a cup of tea.
encounters: A caravan master counts wagons and finds one more than she set out with.
An ostler shoes a mule and tells the yard which road is flooded this week.
Hired guards haggle a rate by the day, the wagon, and the danger.
A wagon is unloaded of crates that are carried straight into the city without a manifest.
sense_hints: A hundred roads' worth of dust and qi mixed in one yard; nothing here is from here.
Mules, wagons, guards' iron and the tea-warm hum of gossip.

Solar Crucible Forge Terraces.description: The forge terraces of Solar Crucible Celestial City: tier on soot-warm tier of workshops and furnaces climbing the slope, ore carts on rails, and the ring of hammers that never quite stops.
encounters: Sparks fall on the lower terrace like slow rain.
An ore cart rattles down the rails and three apprentices scatter from its path.
A foreman tastes a lump of ore, spits, and names the seam it came from.
A furnace vents blue fire and the terrace goes quiet for the length of a breath.
sense_hints: Fire qi rolls off the terraces in waves; the furnaces read as hot as the beast cores in them.
Spirit iron rings in the air, a thin metallic note a sense can follow to the freshest cut.

encounters: A patrol forms up at the ward gate with more spears than usual.
An armourer tests a lamellar coat against a spear point and the crowd counts the rings.
Off-duty soldiers dice in the shade of the barracks wall.
A sergeant drills a line of recruits who have not yet learned to stand still.
sense_hints: Drilled, disciplined qi in ranks; the armoury behind it holds a colder, heavier note.
The ward's warding lines are old and deep, laid down by sect formation masters long ago.

Spirit Jade North District.description: Spirit Jade's noble quarter: walled compounds, lacquered gates and servants who do not look at strangers. The great clans of Spirit Jade Capital keep their townhouses here, and the well-swept lanes between them are swept twice a day.
encounters: Two clan stewards argue over a boundary stone in voices too quiet to carry.
A young master practises sword forms in a courtyard and is watched from three windows.
An invitation is delivered to a compound gate and refused without being opened.
Lanterns are lit along a wall for a banquet that half of Spirit Jade Capital is talking about.
sense_hints: Clan qi sits behind every wall, old and layered, and none of it is offered to a stranger.
The lanes are still and the compounds are not; power breathes behind the lacquered gates.

Spirit Jade East District.description: Spirit Jade's temple quarter: incense, bells and the envoys' halls where the sects keep a presence in Spirit Jade Capital. Pilgrims and disciples cross the well-swept courtyards at every hour, and rumour travels faster than prayer.
encounters: Two envoys from rival sects bow to each other with exact and equal coldness.
A notice at the hall names the disciples accepted this season, and a crowd reads it twice.
A bell rings and the courtyard empties as disciples file into the envoys' hall.
An incense seller offers a stick for luck on a trial and a second for the examiner.
sense_hints: Incense and sect qi thicken the courtyards; a spiritual sense finds three sects' signatures in one breath.
Bells leave a ringing in the qi that lasts long after the sound is gone.

Spirit Jade South District.description: Spirit Jade's lower town: the crowded, well-swept streets below the walls where Spirit Jade Capital actually lives - inns, laundries, gambling dens and the people who hear everything first.
encounters: An innkeeper waves you in, out of the rain, before you have said a word.
A gambling den's shutters bang open and someone comes out lighter than they went in.
A laundress hangs a sect robe out to dry and pretends not to know whose it is.
Children run a race down the alley and a cultivator steps aside for them without breaking stride.
sense_hints: Mortal life-signs crowd every alley; the cultivators among them are easy to pick out and try not to be.
Smoke, wet stone and cheap wine, and under it the quick pulse of a place that never sleeps.

Spirit Jade West District.description: Spirit Jade's ministry row: well-swept halls of clerks, petitioners in queues, seals and stamps and the slow, exact machinery by which Spirit Jade Capital is governed.
encounters: A sect envoy is shown past the queue and everyone in it notices.
The day's edicts are posted and a scribe reads them aloud for the crowd.
Two clerks argue over the wording of a decree that will change nothing.
A clerk stamps a petition with three seals and returns it for a fourth.
sense_hints: Paper, ink and the dry bureaucratic qi of a thousand sealed decisions.
The seals on the halls carry the mandate's authority in a thin, exact line.

Starroad Caravan Yards.description: The caravan yards of Starroad Celestial City: road-worn acres of wagons, mules and hired guards, where every road in the region begins or ends and a rumour costs a cup of tea.
encounters: A caravan master counts wagons and finds one more than she set out with.
An ostler shoes a mule and tells the yard which road is flooded this week.
Hired guards haggle a rate by the day, the wagon, and the danger.
A wagon is unloaded of crates that are carried straight into the city without a manifest.
sense_hints: A hundred roads' worth of dust and qi mixed in one yard; nothing here is from here.
Mules, wagons, guards' iron and the tea-warm hum of gossip.

Stoneback Ore Terraces.description: The ore terraces of Stoneback Mountain City: stone-cold switchbacks of mine mouths and assay huts above the town, where the day's ore is weighed and the miners drink what it earns.
encounters: The ore terrace pays out and the tavern below fills before sunset.
Miners come up the switchback grey with dust and singing badly.
The assayer weighs the day's ore and the foreman disputes the scale.
A mine mouth is boarded up with a warning chalked on the boards.
sense_hints: Earth qi and spirit iron ring from the mine mouths; the freshest vein is the loudest.
Dust, sweat and the deep patient pressure of the mountain.

encounters: A furnace vents blue fire and the terrace goes quiet for the length of a breath.
A smith argues with a broker over the price of beast cores by the basket.
Sparks fall on the lower terrace like slow rain.
An ore cart rattles down the rails and three apprentices scatter from its path.
sense_hints: Fire qi rolls off the terraces in waves; the furnaces read as hot as the beast cores in them.
Spirit iron rings in the air, a thin metallic note a sense can follow to the freshest cut.

Adamant Body Inn.description: The stone-cold inn of Adamant Body Immortal City: a long table, a corner where a travelling merchant sits when one is in town, and a board by the door where the caravan master posts for guards. Whoever is in Adamant Body Immortal City passes through here sooner or later; it is where the city meets.
encounters: The caravan master pins a notice by the door: guards wanted, the road north, pay on arrival.
Two cultivators from different sects share a jug and pretend they have not noticed each other's robes.
The landlord refuses a room to someone whose token he does not like, and says so kindly.
A bard sings a song about Adamant Body Immortal City that gets one thing wrong and everyone corrects it.
sense_hints: Wine, woodsmoke and a dozen qi signatures at rest; the merchant's pack in the corner hums faintly with what it holds.
The inn's threshold ward is old and friendly and remembers every regular.

Jade Meridian Stone Gate.description: A green-stone gate set into a cliff of jade veins above the road to Spirit Jade Capital. The sect's meridian arrays hum in the rock; applicants trace them with a finger and are judged by what they feel.
encounters: A warden lays a formation flag on the stone and asks an applicant to name which line is wrong.
Jade dust drifts down the cliff face when the arrays turn over at noon.
An applicant faints at the third array and is carried down by two outer disciples without a word.
A merchant sells "meridian-opening" tea at the foot of the stairs and the wardens let him.
sense_hints: The arrays in the cliff move qi in patterns too regular to be natural.
Ordered, patient qi; the sect above is a place of long practice.

Thousand Beast Valley Mouth.description: The mouth of a wide valley in the Spiritual World, closed by a fence of bone and a gate that a beast, not a man, opens. Cages, kennels and roosts climb the slopes beyond it.
encounters: A warden opens a cage and steps back; the applicant inside it does not.
A hawk the size of a horse lands on the gate and every kennel goes quiet.
Two applicants argue over which of them the valley cat chose, and the cat leaves with neither.
A hunter from the capital sells a cub at the gate and is told to bring the mother.
sense_hints: Beast qi in a hundred flavours crowds the valley beyond the gate.
Something old and very large sleeps under the far ridge and the valley arranges itself around it.

Heavenblade Sword Terrace.description: A terrace of immortal gold cut into the mountain above the Immortal Court, where a single sword stands point-down in the stone and has for ten thousand years. Applicants are asked to draw it and are judged by how they fail.
encounters: An applicant touches the terrace sword and is thrown thirty paces; the elder nods approval.
Gold dust rises from the terrace when the wind carries the sword's intent down the mountain.
A sword cultivator from another sect stands at the edge of the terrace and does not step onto it.
A child of the Court draws a stick from the ground in imitation and the elder does not laugh.
sense_hints: Sword intent cuts the air above the terrace in a line that has not moved in ten thousand years.
The mountain above is disciplined qi in rows; a sword sect at practice.

Ashen Lotus Shrine Gate.description: A shrine gate of grey stone in a burnt lotus field below the Immortal Court, where the ash never settles. The pavilion recruits openly here, which the Court tolerates because it cannot stop it.
encounters: Grey lotus petals fall upward from the field and nobody remarks on it.
An applicant walks out of the ash a day later, older, and is admitted.
A Court patrol passes the gate at a distance and looks straight ahead.
The keeper lights a lamp with no oil in it and it burns grey.
sense_hints: Soul qi rises off the ash field in slow spirals; something below it is patient.
Cold fire and colder intent; the shrine is a door, not a wall.

Mandate Academy Star Steps.description: Nine hundred steps of starlight rise from the Palace grounds to the Academy's first hall. Each step asks a question; applicants who reach the top have answered them.
encounters: An applicant stops at the four-hundredth step and sits down to think, and is left alone for three days.
Starlight runs down the steps like water at dusk.
A lecturer reads an answer aloud to the whole stair and the stair goes quiet.
A Palace official climbs ten steps for show and turns back at the eleventh.
sense_hints: Celestial law presses on the steps in graded weights; each landing is heavier.
The Academy above is ordered qi arranged by argument rather than rank.

Void Serpent Pit.description: A pit in the Celestial World whose bottom nobody has seen, ringed by serpent-carved stones. The cult recruits at the rim, and the Palace lets it, because the pit was here before the Palace.
encounters: A rope is lowered into the pit and comes back frayed and empty.
The stones around the rim are warm on the coldest nights.
An applicant climbs out with a serpent coiled on one arm and is admitted on the spot.
A Palace astronomer measures the pit's depth every year and records a different number.
sense_hints: Serpent qi coils up out of the pit in slow waves; the rim is the only still ground.
Something vast turns over far below and the whole rim breathes with it.

Adamant Body Forge.description: Adamant Body's smithy: a stone-cold forge hall where Smith Guo Tie hammers spirit iron into blades and lamellar at the anvil, and sells the ore beside them. Tier 3 work - immortal-grade goods few can afford. The forge sits off Adamant Body Immortal City's main street and closes only when the coals do.
encounters: A young cultivator haggles over a lamellar coat and leaves with a promise to come back with ore instead.
The coals flare blue as a beast core is fed to the forge, and the whole shop smells of scorched qi.
A sect runner collects a crate of swords and counts every one before signing the ledger.
Smith Guo Tie refuses to sharpen a blade whose edge was chipped in a duel, and says why.
sense_hints: Fire qi pours off the forge in waves; the beast cores in the coals burn hotter than wood ever could.
Every blade on the rack carries a thread of the smith's qi, laid in at the quench.

Adamant Body Array Workshop.description: Adamant Body's array workshop: a stone-cold workshop of chalk lines and etched disks where Array Master Lin Lan inscribes minor arrays and stocks blanks and flags. Tier 3 inscription - immortal-grade goods few can afford. It keeps a quiet courtyard off Adamant Body Immortal City's old wall.
encounters: Formation flags stand in a rack by the door, each tied with the colour of its element.
A sect envoy from near Adamant Body Immortal City orders a warding disk and pays half in advance.
Array Master Lin Lan corrects a novice's array with one line and does not charge for it.
The workshop's own warding array hums faintly whenever someone crosses the threshold.
sense_hints: The courtyard's chalk lines glow faintly to a spiritual sense, an array half-drawn and waiting.
Etched disks on the shelf hold their qi still, like water in a bowl.

Tier 1 stock - mortal-grade goods for the road. It faces Ashenwall City's market square and knows every traveller by their boots.
encounters: Shopkeeper Shen Ping weighs out spirit iron on a scale that has been argued with for years.
A traveller asks what is new on the roads into Ashenwall City and gets the whole morning's gossip.

sense_hints: Road dust and a dozen different qi signatures cling to the stock, none of them strong.
The one spatial pouch on the shelf folds space a finger's width and is worth more than the building.

Azure Crown Apothecary.description: Azure Crown's apothecary: a well-swept shop of drawers and cauldrons where Physician Fang Jun refines pills at the back and sells herbs from the front. Tier 2 craft - spirit-grade goods a cultivator relies on. Found down a side lane of Azure Crown Imperial City, marked by the smell of simmering medicine.
encounters: A cauldron at the back hisses and Physician Fang Jun lifts the lid on a batch of pills nearly done.
A farmer from outside Azure Crown Imperial City trades a basket of spirit herbs for a single recovery pill and counts it fair.
The drawers are labelled in a hand that has clearly relabelled them many times over the years.
A disciple asks for something to calm a heart demon and is sold tea and a long talk instead.
sense_hints: Medicinal qi hangs in the air, layered like the drawers - bitter, sweet, then something sharp from the cauldron.
The pills cooling at the back hum faintly with the herbs that went into them.

Azure Crown Talisman Hall.description: Azure Crown's talisman hall: a well-swept scriptorium where Talisman-Scribe Xue Wen brushes talismans at a long table and sells paper and ink to anyone who would try their own hand. Tier 2 script - spirit-grade goods a cultivator relies on. It stands near Azure Crown Imperial City's temple quarter.
encounters: A traveller buys ten sheets of talisman paper and asks, hopefully, whether the ink does the work.
Stacked brushes, each for one talisman only, line the wall in the order they were made.
A child from Azure Crown Imperial City copies the strokes on a discarded sheet and gets them almost right.
A talisman drawn wrong fizzes and blackens in a bowl of water kept for the purpose.
sense_hints: Ink and paper carry a thin charge; a finished talisman on the drying stone flickers at the edge of sight.
The scribe's brush leaves a trail of qi that fades a heartbeat after the stroke.

encounters: Hermit Zeng Shan rings the bell once at noon and a traveller bound for Riverguard City stops mid-stride to bow.
A bowl of rice has been left at the stone and the birds have not touched it.
An old soldier from Greenriver Town sits with his back to the stone and says nothing for an hour.
The wind moves the prayer strips and for a moment they all point the same way.
sense_hints: The ground within sound of the bell is still - no beast qi, no killing intent, only the hermit's steady breath.
Generations of offerings have left the stone with a warmth sense can feel and hands cannot.

Toppled Stele Ruin.description: A ruin beside the herb forest valleys road between Hundred Herb Spirit City and Jade Crown Spirit City: fallen stones older than either city, half-buried by seasons, picked over by Scavenger Bai Jun and never quite emptied. Things surface here after rain. Cultivators say the ground under it is not always the same ground.
encounters: Rain has washed the soil from a carved step that was not there last season.
Scavenger Bai Jun turns a shard over in the light and puts it back exactly where it lay.
A cold draught comes up from between two fallen stones on a windless day.
A cultivator from Hundred Herb Spirit City paces the ruin's edge with a compass that will not settle.
sense_hints: The stones hold a residue older than any sect - faint, layered, and not quite dormant.
Under the rubble the qi runs in a pattern, as if a formation once stood here and has not entirely stopped.

Dust Road Waystation.description: A waystation halfway along the river plains road between Immortal River City and Skyroad Immortal City: a walled yard, a well, stabling, and a stall under the eaves where Keeper He Kun sells travellers what the road takes out of them - pills, paper, a hot meal - and buys what they carry in. Travellers from both cities stop here; so do the merchants.
encounters: A carter from Immortal River City argues the price of a hot meal with Keeper He Kun and loses cheerfully.
Two travellers bound for Skyroad Immortal City compare notes on the road ahead and agree it is worse than last year.
A mule kicks over a bucket at the well and every dog in the yard wakes.
A merchant's pack train fills the yard and Keeper He Kun counts heads before opening the gate.
sense_hints: Mortal life-signs cluster in the yard - carters, hostlers, a few cultivators too tired to hide it.
The well carries a thread of earth qi; the road either side carries only dust.

Blue Tile Waystation.description: A waystation halfway along the fortified dry plains road between Ironbanner City and Moonfen City: a walled yard, a well, stabling, and a stall under the eaves where Keeper Ji Rong sells travellers what the road takes out of them - pills, paper, a hot meal - and buys what they carry in. Ash Wolf Hunting Ground.description: A hunting ground off the herb forest valleys road between Jade Cauldron Immortal City and Ninefold Noble Immortal City, where the beasts come down to water and the hunters of both cities set their snares. Hunter Kang Yi keeps a lean-to at its edge and knows every trail. The best hunting on this road, and the least safe.
encounters: Fresh spoor crosses the trail, deep enough that the beast that left it was carrying something.
Hunter Kang Yi holds up a hand and the whole clearing goes silent, waiting.
A snare has been sprung and emptied by something that was not the hunter who set it.
A pair of hunters from Ninefold Noble Immortal City drag a carcass to the trailhead and argue over whose arrow took it.
sense_hints: Beast qi crosses the clearing in old, well-worn lines, heavier toward the water.
Something larger than the usual game sleeps further in, and its breathing moves the undergrowth.
